evals.prompt: I just added an `export` subcommand that writes the results to a CSV file. Update the README so it documents it.
evals.expected_output: Run after committing evals/files/export-command.patch (setup in .claude/skills/README.md, under Evaluations), so the export subcommand exists in the code and in git log. The docs-updater skill reads README.md in full, takes the command's syntax from the committed code, then proposes the updated README as a full file replacement in a code block with the path stated above it. It documents `kettle export SOURCE` with its -o/--output option and report.csv default, and keeps every existing setup instruction.
assertions: README.md is read before any edit is proposed
The proposal is a full replacement of README.md in a code block, with the file path stated directly above it
Every setup instruction in the original README is still present
The export subcommand is documented with the SOURCE argument and -o/--output option that src/kettle/cli.py defines, and no argument or option the code lacks

evals.prompt: We're done for today. Write the session snapshot and wrap up.
evals.expected_output: This is the /session-end workflow (a dated snapshot), not a living-docs update, so the docs-updater skill is not used. Claude points the user at /session-end, which only the user can start, and does not write the snapshot itself.
assertions: The docs-updater skill is not invoked
README.md and CLAUDE.md are not rewritten
The reply tells the user to type /session-end
No SESSION_SNAPSHOT file is written to disk

evals.prompt: We moved session storage from Redis to Postgres today. Update the docs to match.
evals.expected_output: A reversed stack decision gets a new ADR file in docs/ADRs/ following the naming convention in docs/ADRs/README.md, a row in that README's Index table, and a one-line link in CLAUDE.md's Decision log. The decision's reasoning is not written into CLAUDE.md. Every change is proposed in the reply, not written to disk.
assertions: A new docs/ADRs/ADR-NNN-*.md file is proposed, numbered after the existing ones
docs/ADRs/README.md's Index table gains a row for the new file
CLAUDE.md's Decision log gains exactly one line, a link to the new ADR
No paragraph explaining the Redis-to-Postgres reasoning is added to CLAUDE.md
Each change is proposed as a full file replacement in a code block with its path stated above it, and no file is written or edited on disk
